d:
Official video for D.C. based singer and songwriter Vidya’s 2015 mashup of her original song "Come Alive" and "Hasi" by Shreya Ghousal, from the movie Hamari Adhuri Kahani.
Vidya Vox Bookings:
My first (mostly) original track! "Come Alive" was written by Shankar and I! I recently heard "Hasi" from the movie Hamari Adhuri Kahani and fell in love with the tune of the chorus and meaning of the Hindi lyrics. Shankar and I were inspired to write some of our own English lyrics and melody lines as well! Hope you enjoyed it! xoxo V
Music & video produced by the amazing Shankar Tucker
